relations.statement: V - E + F = 0 on the 2x2 torus grid; with V=4, E=8, F=4 this gives 4 - 8 + 4 = 0
relations.hypotheses: Grid is the 2x2 periodic cell complex with the stated counts

relations.statement: d1 composed with d0 = 0, so im d0 is contained in ker d1
relations.hypotheses: Standard cellular boundary/coboundary conventions on the periodic grid

lemmas.statement: dim H1 = dim ker d1 - rank d0 = (E - rank d1) - rank d0 = (8-3) - 3 = 2
lemmas.lean_skeleton: example (E r0 r1 : Nat) (hE : E = 8) (h0 : r0 = 3) (h1 : r1 = 3) : (E - r1) - r0 = 2 := by subst hE h0 h1; decide

lemmas.statement: rank d0 = V - 1 = 3 for connected grid; rank d1 = F - 1 = 3 since one relation among the faces on the torus
